I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. As for "my API"—I think you might be asking one of a few things:

1. **Which API am I accessed through?** If you're chatting with me here, you're likely using a specific interface (like Claude.ai or a third-party app). I don't have visibility into exactly how you're accessing me.

2. **How can you use Claude via API?** Anthropic offers the Claude API for developers. You can find documentation and sign up at **https://www.anthropic.com/api** or **https://console.anthropic.com**.

3. **What model/version am I?** I can't always confirm my exact version, but I'm part of the Claude family of models by Anthropic.

Could you clarify what you're looking for? I'm happy to help!
